literal_meaning: উনানের দিকে মুখ করা (facing the oven or fire)
figurative_meaning_en: Unlucky or ill-fated; a special abusive term for women
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা উনানমুখী মেয়ে, কিছুই ঠিক হয় না তার জীবনে।
এই উনানমুখীটাকে কেন আমার সাথে জড়ালে?
example_sentences_in_english: She's such an unlucky girl; nothing ever goes right in her life.
Why did you pair me with this fire-faced wretch?
note: This idiom draws from the imagery of facing fire, implying constant misfortune, commonly used in rural or semi-urban Bengali speech as a derogatory term.
